description: Erection of a front roof extension involving an increase in the ridge height by 300mm; erection of a dormer window to replace the existing window in the rear roofslope; alterations to the roof of ground floor rear back addition to form a flat roof and installation of bi-fold doors in the rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

P2;
P4; and
P6

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Party walls and ground floor rear wall: Yellow London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern. 

- Roof extension: Natural or artificial grey/black slates which shall match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof.

- Dormers face/cheeks: Clad in lead.

- Windows: Timber frames, colour, style, detail and finish to match the existing windows.

- Ground floor rear doors: Grey powder coated aluminium frames.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - No part of any roofs of the extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roof(s). No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof(s), and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roof(s).

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).
